versionSource: Best-effort reconstruction with per-verse layered witness attribution: Hebrew DSS fragments (4Q216/4Q218/4Q219/4Q220/4Q221/4Q222/4Q223-224/4Q225-227 + Masada Jubilees + 1Q17/1Q18/2Q19/2Q20/3Q5/11Q12; 4Q216 dated late 2nd c. BCE per Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994 — among the oldest Jubilees witnesses) as PRIMARY where preserved; Greek fragments (Epiphanius, Syncellus, Cedrenus) SECONDARY where they exist (limited coverage); Ge'ez (Charles 1902 PD + VanderKam 1989 modern critical) TERTIARY and fallback. Ge'ez is the only complete witness; Hebrew is the original composition language; Greek translation existed but survives only in patristic citations.

provenance.baseText: Layered Hebrew, Greek, and Ge'ez witness reconstruction
provenance.method: Best-effort reconstruction with per-verse layered witness attribution.

sourceCitation: Milik, J. T., and VanderKam, J. C., 'Jubilees' in Qumran Cave 4: VIII, Parabiblical Texts, Part 1 (DJD XIII, Oxford 1994) — THE foundational publication of the DSS Hebrew Jubilees fragments. VanderKam, J. C., The Book of Jubilees: A Critical Text and Translation (CSCO 510-511; Scriptores Aethiopici 87-88; Leuven 1989) — THE standard modern critical Ge'ez edition + English translation. Charles, R. H., The Book of Jubilees, or the Little Genesis (London 1902; Public Domain) — the classic Ge'ez critical edition + English. VanderKam, J. C., Jubilees: A Commentary in Two Volumes (Hermeneia, Minneapolis 2018) — THE standard modern critical commentary. Segal, M., The Book of Jubilees: Rewritten Bible, Redaction, Ideology and Theology (JSJSup 117, Leiden 2007). Kugel, J. L., A Walk through Jubilees (JSJSup 156, Leiden 2012). Werman, C., Sefer ha-Yovelim: Introduction, Hebrew Text, Commentary (Jerusalem 2015) — Hebrew critical edition. Tigchelaar, E. J. C., 'Jubilees' in Outside the Bible (eds. Feldman et al., Philadelphia 2013).

subtitles.en: Ship A: Primeval + Patriarchal Frame (Jubilees 1-12) — 12 chapters. Moses on Sinai + Creation + Eden + Watchers + Flood + 364-day-calendar polemic + Tower of Babel + Abraham.

descriptions.en: Jubilees 1–12 translated verse by verse from the Hebrew, Greek and Ge'ez witnesses: creation, the Watchers, the Flood, the 364-day calendar and Abraham's youth.
